The installer packages/imas-alambic/install/imasdb.sh, which carries the bulk of §5, still has no committed test (git grep finds none under tests/); its behaviour is measured only by the live self-checks it runs on intr26-2, which pass whatever the script's logic does, so a regression that dropped --no-bin or the exec-permission pass would redden no committed test.
justifications.evidence: The gate logs name their revision, tree and command on the header lines and end with EXIT= (settings-base.log rev 4c4fe4a7 10 passed EXIT=0, settings-head.log rev 4477f85d 11 passed EXIT=0, ruff.log EXIT=0). The negative control mutates a scratch copy so the refusal propagates and the new test fails (1 failed, 10 passed EXIT=1), the failing id absent from both head arms, so the guard is shown to fire. I independently reproduced the live claims over ssh: /home/SharedFolder/d240044 mode 1755, launcher 755, --version 0.1.dev6051+g4477f85d0 both with PYTHONPATH set and unset, config reporting maps/current, ids and machine jt-60sa, uv pip show not editable, uv pip check 24 compatible, and find -not -type l -perm -o+w empty. One follow-on records the tests-dir log's revision stamp.
justifications.fit: The settings change is idiomatic: a single try/except returning (path, refusal) documented by a docstring stating the mechanism (packages/imas-alambic/src/imas_alambic/settings.py:170-186), and the shell change keeps set -euo pipefail and the installer's section headers. No plan, ticket, sprint or version identifiers appear in the source paths, symbols or comments.
justifications.goal_fidelity: The three follow-on findings against the earlier install run (r-20261007T081209804162) are each closed: settings.py reports the machine and the cache/IDS store lookups as source-with-no-value when bundle discovery refuses (packages/imas-alambic/src/imas_alambic/settings.py:156-217), so config is readable before any bundle exists; imasdb.sh no longer seeds maps/current and reads the layout names from config alone (packages/imas-alambic/install/imasdb.sh:161-175); and the dispatched gate log now stamps the correct revision and carries an EXIT= line. The repair also installs with --no-bin and opens executables to others r-x, both plan clauses.
justifications.reuse: The change reuses the existing resolve_store_root and MachineMapError from machine_map rather than reimplementing discovery, and removes the installer's duplicate ownership of the maps/current layout name so settings.py stays its single owner. No new capability or parallel path is added.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --name-only 4c4fe4a7..4477f85d lists exactly the four declared write paths (the evidence fragment, imasdb.sh, settings.py, test_settings.py), and the declared figures directory was correctly left unwritten because the dispatched done-when names no figure.
